{{Quote|What would anybody want with that nasty chunk of rock?''"<br />"''Precisely what Alliance HQ wants to know, little chum. A fully-operational Imperial base &mdash; in the middle of nowhere, a modest eternity from the nearest line of conflict. What are those grub-weasels up to?|Alliance operatives|<ref name="Science">{{WEGCite|story=Ain't Science Grand?|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an '''asteroid base''' to construct their [[collector-repulsor array]]. The facility contained production lines for low-yield [[repulsorlift motor]]s and a [[Rectenna/Legends|scanning bowl]] seemingly for a [[Communications array/Legends|communications array]], recreation and living quarters for the base personnel, and a secure [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] buried deep in the rock of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]].<ref name="Science" />
